task.description:
Execute the full test suite for EPIC-3 scheduler changes.

1. Pre-checks: backend services running, BPM_TEST_DB_URL configured
2. Run: zig build test (unit tests)
3. Run: zig build test-integration (integration tests including scheduler tests)
4. Verify: ISS-301, ISS-302, ISS-303 specific tests pass
5. Write report: tests/reports/report-epic3-<date>.yaml
acceptance_criteria: ISS-303 exhaustion test: timer FAILED + DLQ entry verified
ISS-302 startup lock test: both paths (acquired / not acquired) pass

result.summary: EPIC-3 scheduler integration tests failed due to pre-existing schema-per-tenant infrastructure. Unit tests: PASS (548/637, 5 pre-existing auth failures only). Migration 092: PASS (confirmed applied to test DB). Integration tests: FAIL — all 31 failures (including 4 new EPIC-3 scheduler tests) caused by business tables (timers, instance_projections, events, dead_letter_queue) residing in per-tenant schemas, not in public, preventing unqualified table access. EPIC-3 implementation cannot be verified until test fixtures are schema-qualified.

issues.description: TC-SCH-303-03, TC-SCH-303-04, TC-SCH-301-03, TC-SCH-302-03 all fail: sch303_timer_dlq_test.zig inserts into instance_projections/timers/events without schema qualification; these tables are in per-tenant schemas after migrations 060/069/086. Scheduler.processNextDueTimer also queries FROM timers without schema prefix.

zig build migrate fails on dev DB: GBL-082_fix_audit_chain_resource_id_text.sql out-of-order (max applied: 092_iss303_timer_fire_error_count.sql). Dev DB has GBL-082_iss101_timers_failed_status.sql applied under a different filename.

27 pre-existing integration test failures across iss207, iss208, iss205, iss102, iss203, iss202, iss107, audit_iss103, tnt_backfill — same schema-per-tenant infrastructure root cause. Documented in WF02-iss207-208-205 report.

result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV: (1) Fix sch303_timer_dlq_test.zig fixture setup to use schema-qualified tables or a LEGACY_RLS test tenant. (2) Fix Scheduler.processNextDueTimer to be schema-aware. (3) Resolve GBL-082 migration naming conflict on dev DB. Then redispatch TEST-RUNNER.
